ring-telemetryops.name: Ring TelemetryOps
ring-telemetryops.summary: Diagnostic agent for Ring video doorbells, built for the Amazon Developer Hackathon 2026. OpenCV measures the stream, a deterministic pre-check sets the severity, and Claude Haiku 4.5 on Amazon Bedrock reasons over the evidence. A local fallback keeps the same report contract when Bedrock is unavailable.
ring-telemetryops.fact: 869 pytest + 195 Node tests, per the README

hybrid-rag-api.name: Hybrid RAG API
hybrid-rag-api.summary: A hybrid RAG engine written from scratch, without LangChain or LlamaIndex. Dense search (pgvector, HNSW) and lexical search (PostgreSQL GIN) are fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and every answer cites document and page.
hybrid-rag-api.fact: RRF with k = 60 over HNSW and GIN

wakemap.name: WakeMap
wakemap.summary: Flutter prototype from my dissertation: location-based alarms with geofencing, voice-created alarms and an AI travel guide. A Node.js/Express proxy keeps the Gemini key on the server.
wakemap.fact: Android and iOS builds, Gemini behind a server proxy

ai-surveillance-hub.name: AI Surveillance Hub
ai-surveillance-hub.summary: An Arduino proximity trigger wakes a Raspberry Pi camera that runs YOLOv8, sends a Telegram photo alert and logs each detection to a Flask dashboard.

secure-auth-go.name: Secure Auth Go
secure-auth-go.summary: Go web app for gym membership records, built for a web security course: bcrypt, server-side sessions, CSRF tokens, CSP headers, role-based access and login rate limiting.

mediterranean-churros.name: Mediterranean Churros
mediterranean-churros.summary: Landing page in five languages for a churros brand in Switzerland, built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and next-intl.
